lang.label: Language
hero.lede: Explore at your own pace, understand what you're going through, and reach a person when you're ready. No sign-up needed to start.
footer.tagline: A space to feel heard. A pathway to feel supported.
footer.urgent2: SAATHI is not an emergency service and does not provide diagnosis or treatment.
hero.kicker: You look after everyone. This space is for you, too.
start.title: There is no right way to arrive here.
start.lede: Maybe you want a quiet moment. Maybe something has been on your mind. You can explore without creating an account or telling us your story.
start.close: Take what feels useful and leave the rest. You can come back whenever you need a moment for yourself.
footer.emergency: Emergency numbers in India, free from any phone
